validationRule.title: ID in one feed missing from the other
validationRule.errorDescription: a trip_id that is provided in the VehiclePositions feed should be provided in the TripUpdates feed, and a vehicle_id that is provided in the TripUpdates feed should be provided in the VehiclePositions feed

occurrenceList.prefix: trip_id 1.1 is in TripUpdates but not in VehiclePositions feed
vehicle_id vOnlyTU is in TripUpdates but not in VehiclePositions feed
vehicle_id vOnlyVP is in VehiclePositions but not in TripUpdates feed
trip_id 1.2 is in VehiclePositions but not in TripUpdates feed

validationRule.title: Vehicle position outside agency coverage area
validationRule.errorDescription: The vehicle position should be inside the agency coverage area.  This is defined as within roughly 1/8 of a mile (200 meters) of the GTFS shapes.txt data, or stops.txt locations if the GTFS feed doesn't include shapes.txt.

occurrenceList.prefix: vehicle.id vOnlyVP at (40.0,-73.0) is more than 1609.0 meters (1.00 mile(s)) outside entire GTFS shapes.txt coverage area

validationRule.title: Header timestamp is older than 65 seconds
validationRule.errorDescription: The data in a GTFS-realtime feed should always be less than one minute old
validationRule.occurrenceSuffix: old which is greater than the recommended age of 65 seconds

validationRule.title: GTFS-rt content changed but has the same header timestamp
validationRule.errorDescription: The GTFS-rt header timestamp value should always change if the feed contents change - the feed contents must not change without updating the header timestamp
validationRule.occurrenceSuffix: was the same for this and the previous feed iteration but the feed content was not the same

validationRule.title: trip doesn't have any stop_time_updates
validationRule.errorDescription: Unless a trip's schedule_relationship is CANCELED, a trip must have at least one stop_time_update
validationRule.occurrenceSuffix: doesn't have any stop_time_updates and isn't CANCELED

validationRule.title: schedule_relationship not populated
validationRule.errorDescription: trip.schedule_relationship and stop_time_update.schedule_relationship should be populated
